top_signals.title: Oil Dips, Stock Futures Rise as Iran Tensions Ease: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Oil dropped and US equity-index futures rallied as the US and Iran refrained from retaliatory strikes, easing concerns over potential disruptions to Middle East energy supplies after a recent escalation in the conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian leader is scheduled to meet with U.S. President  Donald Trump later this week.
